label: O(n**2)
bound: 4*SumFirst(pairs,n) + 3*n + |output| + 3, where SumFirst sums pairs[t][0] over the n test cases (value-bounded per-test inner loop)

label: O(n)
bound: 40 * n + 3 * SumFirst(pairs, n) + 4, where SumFirst sums each test case's own n-value

label: O(n)
bound: 13*n + BoundFor(abc_list[..min(n,|abc_list|)]) + 2, where BoundFor sums 3*(|x|+|y|+|z|)+20 per row
